Senior GenAI Solutions Architect

About us
Northwind Health is a fictional life-sciences company used for testing. We value curiosity.

What you'll do:
- Design and lead the architecture of multi-agent LLM applications on Azure, from proof of concept to production
- Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines over regulated scientific documents
- Set up evaluation with golden datasets and RAGAS, and gate releases on the results
- Partner with stakeholders in research and drug safety to turn needs into roadmaps

Requirements:
- 7+ years of software engineering experience, 2+ years building with LLMs
- Strong Python and FastAPI; experience deploying containers on AKS / Kubernetes
- Hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search and vector search
- Experience with CI/CD (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps) and infrastructure as code (Terraform or Bicep)
- Experience with LangGraph or Semantic Kernel
- Experience in GxP or other regulated environments
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent

Nice to have:
- Fine-tuning with LoRA
- Experience with Snowflake
- Knowledge graphs or ontologies (MeSH, MedDRA)

Benefits
- Health insurance and 401(k)
This role is hybrid, 3 days on-site in New Jersey. Visa sponsorship is not available.
